<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 9+"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Linguist's Dictionary](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2180)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Divination" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=47" />
<trait label="Grimoire" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=387" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 112 <sup>1.1</sup>

_[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) Items with effects that have an undetermined duration, end their effects at the end of a scenario or adventure unless specifically stated otherwise by the campaign rules._

<row gap="medium">

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Bound in sturdy leather, this thick book has several colorful bookmarks and page dividers. Its title and text shift between numerous languages.

**Activate** <actions string="Free Action" /> envision;  **Frequency** once per day;  **Requirements** Your last action was to cast a spell prepared from this grimoire that allows understanding of another language, such as [_comprehend languages_](/Spells.aspx?ID=46) or [_tongues_](/Spells.aspx?ID=340); **Effect** The grimoire absorbs knowledge of one language translated this way (caster's choice if more than one), allowing its bearer to communicate on a rudimentary level in that language even after the spell's duration has elapsed. The _linguist's dictionary_ can hold one language at a time.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

The dictionary can hold three languages at a time.
